notes: Homonym correction: the requested niphal "be negligent" and hiphil "mislead; deceive" senses are not attested under H7951 -- they belong to the separate Strong's homonym H7952 (same spelling שָׁלָה, distinct number), confirmed both by Strong's own entries and by the corpus (H7951 has 5 attestations, all qal; H7952 has 2, one niphal one hiphil). Added H7952 as its own root, שלה² (BDB actually treats both as one root with qal/niphal/hiphil together, but this project follows Strong's numbering, which splits them).
